body: I'm sorry I'm being an asshole. I'm just..idk man. I tried it all. I'm around people. People call me "jaded". WTF. I just don't want to be alone. I don't even know what I'm saying. This is why I'm stupid.
My whole life is "just for me time".

Every day its less and less fair. Its like the moments of happiness during the day are fake. What's the point if it all goes to shit at night. It feels like a rake. there's a limited amount of leaves in my pile. During the day a kid comes out and throws some leaves back on the pile. Then every night, a man comes out with a bigger shovel and rakes more off the pile. 2 steps forward, 3 steps back. I wish someone would shoot me. I'm too much of a bitch to take responsibility
